description_en: Retrieves a list of dataset records
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem list-dataset-records --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --lang zh --dataset-id dataset-nhcrmjpx1zsorlaq0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --role-for 1130916744880000 --max-results 50 --next-token AAAAAUqcj6VO4E3ECWIrFczs0000 --filter '{"field1":"value1","field2":"value2"}' --order desc --order-field updatetime --api-version 2024-12-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataSetRecords

parameters.help_en:
The region of the data management center for Threat Analysis. Select the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

`cn-hangzhou`: For assets in the Chinese mainland.

`ap-southeast-1`: For assets in regions outside mainland China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地。
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
返回消息的语言类型。取值：
zh（默认）：中文。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页参数：每页显示条数
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The user ID that an administrator can use to view data as another member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return for each request when `NextToken` is used for pagination. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The filter conditions, specified as a JSON string. For example: {"field1":"value1","field2":"value2"}
parameters.help_zh:
字段模糊匹配，json字符串，例如
{"field1":"value1","field2":"value2"}
parameters.name: filter
